data.exact_reserve_text: An unfavourable run off deviation (prior accident year deterioration) of GBP 3.9m (2019: GBP 3.1m) was experienced during the year.

named_events.loss_description: The underwriting result in 2020 was significantly affected by losses relating to COVID-19 which resulted in GBP 4.5m of net claims.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 were GBP 32.848m. During 2020 the Syndicate experienced an unfavourable prior-accident-year run-off deviation of GBP 3.9m (gross), representing an adverse prior-year development (strengthening) of about 11.9% of opening reserves. The 2020 underwriting result was also impacted by COVID-19, which produced GBP 4.5m of net claims in the year. No specific prior accident years or other named historical loss events are explicitly identified as driving the GBP 3.9m deterioration.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount taken from Note 5 textual disclosure stating a GBP 3.9m prior accident year deterioration. The note does not present a tabular insurance-liabilities (gross) column but the movement statement in Note 5 is the designated 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' disclosure and has been treated as a gross amount. Gross claims triangle figures are shown in Note 10 in GBP 000s (thousands). The segmental analysis is limited; the syndicate reports a single business segment 'long-term insurance business', which is used for gross_premium_mix. There was a prior period restatement noted (Note 19) which affected receivables and payables balances but does not change the textual prior year movement referenced here.
